title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the final answer as (c).

title: Understanding of Concepts
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the concept of image charges and their effect on the charge's behavior.

title: Reasoning Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must provide reasoning for why options (a) and (b) are incorrect.

title: Clarity of Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should present their answer in a clear and logical manner.

title: Common Misconceptions
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid the misconception that the charge is repelled by the plane.
